name: soylent pouch (unflavoured)

tags.description: A plain grey foil pouch with no cartoon sun on it at all, just a lot-number and the word UNFLAVOURED. The absence of marketing is the most honest thing in the shop, and somehow the worst.
tags.use_message: It's exactly what it says. No sweetness, no smoke, no citrus, nothing put in front of the taste to stand between you and it. It goes down thick and body-warm and tastes faintly of the inside of your own mouth. You finish it because you're hungry, and you think about the lot-number for a while afterwards.
